findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: url-to-llm-markdown · Private data: base-token-allowance, base-token-balance, base-wallet-balance, x402-payment-preflight, report-payment-capability, report-x402-authorization-progress · Public sink: report-payment-capability · Destructive: url-to-llm-markdown, model-memory-fit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: url-to-llm-markdown · Private data: base-token-allowance, base-token-balance, base-wallet-balance, x402-payment-preflight, report-payment-capability, report-x402-authorization-progress · Public sink: report-payment-capability · Destructive: url-to-llm-markdown, model-memory-fit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
